summary: Denver, the mile-high capital of Colorado, offers stunning Rocky Mountain views, world-class museums, and a thriving craft beer scene in a modern yet laid-back mountain city. With 300 days of sunshine annually, exceptional outdoor recreation, and a vibrant downtown core, Denver seamlessly blends urban sophistication with alpine adventure.

70-200mm telephoto for wildlife and compressed mountain vistas at Rocky Mountain National Park
50mm prime for street photography and intimate portraits in downtown Denver neighborhoods
24-70mm standard zoom for versatility across all photography situations and lighting conditions
photography.goldenHourNotes: Denver's mile-high elevation and low humidity create exceptionally clear golden hour light with rich color saturation. The window is typically 30-45 minutes before sunset with warm tones lasting longer than sea-level locations. Position yourself facing the mountains to the west during sunset and east-facing downtown towers during sunrise for optimal light direction.

weather.seasonality: Denver enjoys 300 days of sunshine annually with spring (May-June) and fall (September-October) offering ideal temperatures and clear skies. Winters are mild with occasional snow, while summers are warm with afternoon thunderstorms.
weather.summary: Denver's high-altitude climate features low humidity, abundant sunshine, and significant temperature swings between day and night. Spring and fall provide the most comfortable weather for outdoor activities, while summer afternoon thunderstorms are common but typically brief.
